headline: Auxerre after their 3-1: favourites, but only just
summary: Auxerre come home from a 3-1 win at Le Havre, a result Will Still called a reference win, to face promoted Le Mans. The visitors are 16th on 6 points, lost 0-3 at home to Toulouse last time, lose Adil Bourabaa for several weeks and have conceded 10 goals in their last 5 games — which is why over 2.75 goals is 51.8% likely. But Auxerre average only 1.57 expected goals a game, so the market makes them 45.4% favourites, with Le Mans at 28.9%, and rates them just a quarter of a goal better.
read: Promoted Le Mans arrive at the Abbé-Deschamps in the play-off spot after a 0-3 home defeat to Toulouse, while Auxerre come off a 3-1 win at Le Havre. Auxerre are 45.4% favourites and the market rates them about a third of a goal better, with the goal line at 2.75 leaned slightly towards the over.

facts.fact: Le Mans are 16th with 6 points from seven games — the play-off spot, one place above the bottom three.
facts.meaning: A promoted side already fighting the drop, and a defeat at Auxerre keeps them in that scrap.

facts.fact: Auxerre won 3-1 at Le Havre on Sunday, a result coach Will Still called a reference victory.
facts.meaning: They come home on the back of their best attacking afternoon of the run, after two straight away trips.

facts.fact: Auxerre are the market favourites at 45.4%, with Le Mans at 28.9% and the draw at 25.7%.
facts.meaning: Clear favourites at home, but well short of a certainty — the market sees a real away chance.

facts.fact: Le Mans lost 0-3 at home to Toulouse in their last Ligue 1 game, creating 0.95 xG and allowing 1.81.
facts.meaning: Beaten heavily at home by a mid-table side going into a trip to a team that just won away.

facts.fact: Le Mans coach Patrick Videira said Adil Bourabaa is likely to be absent for several weeks and the team must move on without him.
facts.meaning: Le Mans must reshuffle for this trip and the games after it, not just for one afternoon.

facts.fact: The goals market has moved towards more: the over on the 2.75 line went from 49.3% to 51.8% in recent days.
facts.meaning: The market now leans slightly to three goals or more rather than two or fewer.

facts.fact: The Asian handicap fair line sits at -0.25 on Auxerre, i.e. the market rates them only about a third of a goal better.
Auxerre average 1.57 xG for and 1.65 against across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They have taken three wins without out-creating opponents on average — the results are better than the underlying numbers.

sources.fact: Auxerre won 3-1 at Le Havre in their previous Ligue 1 match, a result Will Still called a reference victory.
Auxerre sit 12th with 9 points and host Le Mans at the Abbé-Deschamps after two consecutive away trips.
Before beating Le Havre, Auxerre had arrived at the match in the uncomfortable position of play-off (barragiste) team.
Auxerre will pay tribute before the Le Mans match to a long-time season-ticket holder who died during an amateur match.
Le Mans are the promoted side currently in the play-off spot (16th, 6 points) going into the trip to Auxerre.
Le Mans lost 0-3 at home to Toulouse in their previous Ligue 1 outing.
Le Mans coach Patrick Videira said Adil Bourabaa is likely to be absent for several weeks and the team must move on without him.
